title: Bound fibre variance uniformly in all population counts
statement: Conditional on aggregate N, each species consists of independent labelled particles performing the original symmetric edge walks at rate delta_i. Tensorization and quotienting to counts preserve Poincare. For connected undirected simple n-vertex graphs, the combinatorial Laplacian gap is>=2/[n(n-1)] when n>1. Therefore H=E_pi_bar Var_muN(f)<=n^2/delta_min E_diff(f), uniformly in every count and rare actual class. At n=1 the fibre has one state and H=0. No normalized-time random walk or graph expansion promise changes the physical clock.
